LanguageData.CR_HirePawnsDesc: Call a friendly or neutral faction and hire some of its people for 15 days. Payment is silver in orbital trade beacon range.
LanguageData.CR_NoFaction: No friendly or neutral faction is willing to send help.
LanguageData.CR_Totals: Pawns: {PAWNS} Price: {PRICE} silver Silver in beacon range: {SILVER}
LanguageData.CR_HireTipSilver: Not enough silver. Silver must be in range of a powered orbital trade beacon on this map. {0} more needed.
LanguageData.CR_HiredMessage: {FACTION_name} will send {PAWNS} hirees. They will arrive in about 2–3 days.
LanguageData.CR_ArrivalRefund: Some hirees could not be sent. {SILVER} silver was refunded at the arrival spot.
LanguageData.CR_OrderCancelledHostile: {FACTION_name} is no longer willing to send the pawns you hired. The silver is not refunded.
LanguageData.CR_OrderCancelledNoMap: The pawns hired from {FACTION_name} had nowhere to go, as you have no home map left. The silver is not refunded.
LanguageData.CR_StayText: {PAWN_nameDef} likes your colony a lot. Can {PAWN_pronoun} stay?\n\nAccepting makes {PAWN_objective} a permanent colonist when the contract ends. {FACTION_name} will lose {COST} goodwill with you for losing {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CR_GearWarningText: Your hirees leave in 12 hours. They keep everything they wear and carry when they go.
LanguageData.CR_GearWarningList: These hirees have more than the clothes they came with:
LanguageData.CR_OutpostLostText: Outpost {OUTPOST} has lost pawns - their contract expired and they returned home to {FACTION_name}.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.CR_OutpostLostHostileText: Outpost {OUTPOST} has lost pawns - {FACTION_name} turned hostile and recalled them.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.CR_ForcedText: {PAWN_nameDef} can't travel and stays with you as a permanent colonist.\n\n{SILVER} silver was paid to {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.CR_ForcedGoodwill: You were {SHORT} silver short, so {FACTION_name} lost {GOODWILL} goodwill with you.
